title: The Pillow Book of Sei Shonagon

publication.edition: ed. and trans. Ivan Morris (two volumes); later one-volume printing, Columbia University Press, 1991

access.locator: Library record: The Pillow Book of Sei Shonagon (Columbia University Press, 1967); confirmed via Brill and Cambridge scholarly citations

verification.verification_notes: Publication (New York: Columbia University Press, 1967), Morris as editor-translator, and a 1991 Columbia printing confirmed via Brill endnote citing the Morris translation and independent academic citations; zuihitsu classification confirmed via the Cambridge History chapter record (ch. 14).

limitations: Early-modern Japanese court prose: paratactic juxtaposition, punning, and list rhythm are only partly recoverable in English; the reflective-evaluative stance arrives with the translator's diction.

copyright.notes: Columbia University Press translation copyrighted; original Japanese text is long in the public domain. Described only; no passages reproduced.
